hypothesis: Building on selected parent 4184453b5e7a41a6, keep its 8-row AVX-512 FMA kernel family, B-only 128x128 packing, KC/NC, threshold, and OpenMP ownership, but widen NR from 16 to 32. One A broadcast can then feed two column vectors and the wider tile may reduce per-row-block tile overhead; the additional accumulators may instead increase register pressure. This isolates tile width without assuming it improves n=1024 performance.

transformations: Widened the explicit AVX-512 microkernel from 8x16 to 8x32, using two 16-lane vectors and reusing each row's A broadcast across both vectors.

Expanded the generic scalar tile storage and increased NR to 32; handled incomplete column tiles with separate masks and accessed the high vector only when the tile actually contains columns beyond lane 16.
Kept the selected parent's B-only KC=128, NC=128 packing, direct-access threshold, per-call scratch allocation, and OpenMP disjoint output ownership to isolate the microkernel-width change.
Retained runtime AVX-512F/FMA detection, scalar fallback for row tails or unsupported CPUs, at most eight OpenMP threads, and first-K-panel initialization so each invocation fully overwrites output.
